expected.note_en: TRUMPF signed a five-year replacement facility with two optional extensions. Deutsche Bank, LBBW and UniCredit were bookrunners and mandated lead arrangers. BNP Paribas, Commerzbank, Helaba and HSBC also joined the syndicate. In 2022 it extended the same line to February 2027 and added an ESG component. The amount is committed capacity, with no draw inferred. The audited 2024/25 annual report states that the same EUR500m credit line was extended early in May 2025 through May 2030, with annual extension options to 2032.
